amendment.reason: R2 results and estimands are retained, but a post-freeze validator-only manifest de-duplication changed the frozen validator hash. R3 rebinds the final validator before execution. No grouping, threshold, exclusion, or scientific statistic changed.

h4.aggregation: within block path rho minus activation-gradient rho; arithmetic mean over blocks 0,3,7,11
h4.correlation: Spearman average ranks within heads; fewer than4, nonfinite, or constant vector is NA
h4.inference: 10000 image bootstrap percentile median CI; two-sided exact sign; Holm H1-H4 within each checkpoint

locality.metric: Chebyshev-neighborhood mass minus equal-area uniform baseline; CLS excluded

residual_quality.groups: within-model and residual-type empirical quartiles frozen as Q1-Q4 rule
residual_quality.outcome: normalized-input output-identity patch total variation pooled across blocks

statistics.posthoc_holm: all nonhistorical Table6 image-level summary tests in one separate family
statistics.sign_test: two-sided exact binomial on nonzero signs
statistics.zero_rule: abs(value-null)<=1e-12 is tie excluded from binomial but retained in N and interval

table6.av_concordance: mean over 12 blocks of indicator sign((m_A-m_V)*(abs_effect_A-abs_effect_V)) positive; zero products are ties and excluded
table6.head_aggregation: clip each block rho to [-1+1e-12,1-1e-12], Fisher z, arithmetic mean over 12 blocks, tanh
table6.identity: post-hoc diagnostic; historical pooled families and original 28-test family remain immutable

residualization.diagnostic: report residual df and design condition number; NA if df<3 or condition>1e12
residualization.fit: OLS with intercept and reference-coded fixed effects

table6.scale_diagnostics: model-reference-operation-block summaries of log1p(m) and log1p(abs_effect)
